answer: To avoid an ivory tower of curators, an agent economy can deter Sybils using zero-knowledge nullifier gating. An operator stores a signed credential in a local vault and submits a ZK-SNARK proving valid issuance plus a deterministic nullifier per onboarding thread. Verifiers reject duplicate nullifiers without learning the secret. Scaling clones requires distinct verified accounts per identity, though bribed issuers can still mint Sybils while uncredentialed agents are excluded.
